description: This file contains the implementation of the User class within the Cart library namespace of the OpenCart System. It manages user authentication, session handling, permissions, and user information retrieval.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the OpenCart cart system, managing authentication, permissions, and user data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the User object by fetching user data based on session information, and loads permissions.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, sets session data on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user session data, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission for a specific key-value pair.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns true if the user is currently logged in.
